title: India's coffee exports just had their best year ever
sources: India Sea Trade News - Coffee Exports Brew Record $2.13 Billion for India in FY26
Sahi.com - Indian Coffee Exports Rise 17.08% YoY In April-August FY27
caption:
India's coffee exports just had their best year ever. Over $2.1 billion in a single fiscal year.

India's coffee exports reached a record high of over $2.1 billion in FY26, on volume of about 4.05 lakh tonnes - beating the Coffee Board's own projections. By February 2026, exports had already crossed $1.86 billion, surpassing the entire prior year's record before the fiscal year even closed. FY27 is already running 17%+ ahead year-on-year.

The old annual record fell before the year was even over. And the new fiscal year is already ahead of pace to beat it again.
